task.title: Sidebar hide chevron
task.spec:
Request (user's words): "For our Brigadier, I'll need you to make the sidebar toggle have a chevron with an option (persisted) for users to completely hide the sidebar so that not even the strip is shown, so our sidebar would have 2 modes (strip and fully closed), a chevron like in this screenshot." The attached screenshot (Craft app) shows, at the top right of the sidebar, the sidebar-toggle icon with a small chevron-down right next to it; the chevron opens a menu.

Context:
- Desktop app frontend: apps/desktop/src/components/ui/sidebar.tsx (SidebarProvider, SidebarPanel, useSidebar, the collapse/strip logic and narrow-window auto-collapse), apps/desktop/src/app/AppSidebar.tsx (the toggle at ~line 468, the strip), apps/desktop/src/app/SidebarFoot.tsx, apps/desktop/src/app/TopBar.tsx, apps/desktop/src/styles/globals.css, tokens in apps/desktop/src/styles/tokens.css (lint requires theme tokens for colors/dimensions; raw values go in tokens.css).
- An earlier, unmerged attempt exists on branch `brigadier/96452e60/session`: commits 5524d119 ("Sidebar: chevron menu to collapse to strip or fully hidden, remembered") and 9b3c3e51 ("make the hidden panel inert"). Its visual result was never checked. Start by cherry-picking these two commits onto your branch, then review them critically and fix what is wrong or missing. Its settled design, which you should keep: collapse mode is one persisted choice ("Icon strip" or "Hidden") that applies to every collapse including narrow-window auto-collapse; picking a mode while collapsed switches at once, while expanded it applies on the next collapse; hidden mode makes the panel column width 0, --sidebar-shown 0px, and the panel inert.
- Check in particular: when fully hidden, the user must still have a visible, obvious way to bring the sidebar back (e.g. a toggle in the top bar/window header where the strip used to be, respecting macOS traffic lights) plus the existing keyboard shortcut if there is one; the chevron must be reachable in both expanded and strip states (and wherever the toggle lives in hidden mode); the chevron and menu match the app's existing menu components, icon sizes, hover/focus styles; persistence uses the same mechanism the app already uses for sidebar width/collapsed state; no layout jump or leftover border/gap in hidden mode; the transition animates sensibly.

Safety (mandatory): never touch the installed /Applications/Brigadier.app or its data. Any GUI check uses your own dev build under its own identity and its own data dir (set BRIGADIER_DATA_DIR to a new folder under /tmp, dev identity, never ai.brigadier.app), and drive/screenshot it by its PID only. Kill only that PID when done.

Done when:
- The chevron next to the sidebar toggle opens a menu with the two modes; the choice persists across an app restart.
- Hidden mode shows no strip, no border or gap, and there is a visible control to reopen the sidebar; strip mode behaves as today.
- Typecheck, lint, tests and the frontend build pass…
